title: Geometric Boundaries of the Frohmanian Symplectic Tether: Formal Tracking of the 2D Clock Test and Open Analytic Inputs for Fefferman Statement (B)
description: Standalone formal boundary ledger (`lean/Clay/*.lean`, `latex/geometric_boundaries.tex`, `latex/section10_gaps.tex`, `latex/two_d_fact.tex`, `COMPARATOR.md`, `STATUS.md`) analyzing the exact analytic boundary between algebraic symplectic-tether identities (Pi(u)=0, {F,E}=0) and unforced global smoothness on T^3 (Fefferman Statement B). Includes the 2D clock test showing that constant vortex direction (sin phi = 0) coexists with linear growth ||phi(t)||_infty = M_0^2 t on steady Euler equilibria. Explicitly titled and structured as a boundary and gap ledger (`STATUS.md: not a Clay resolution`), isolating the open analytic obligations (unforced BKM stretching integral finiteness) without using `sorry`.
